name: GameInstance
description: The game's own object: spawned when the engine starts, before any level loads, and kept across level loads. The project picks its class in Project Settings (Game).

methods.name: on_init
methods.doc: Called once, after begin_play and before the first level loads. A Load Level here replaces the default level.

methods.name: on_level_loaded
methods.doc: Called each time a level has loaded and its objects and roles have begun, with the level's project-relative path.

methods.name: on_shutdown
methods.doc: Called once when the game ends, after the level ended and while the game instance's components still exist.
